description: This file defines an authentication context and provider for a React application using Supabase. It manages user session state, authentication methods (email and Google OAuth), and exposes a custom hook for accessing auth state throughout the app.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to children, manages session state, and handles login/logout logic.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook to retrieve the current user's role from metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.
